finalText:
I dug through both the 380-commit log and the PR sheet. Under all the dependency bumps and renames, 12 changes actually touch behavior, and I've written them into `CHANGELOG.md` as 4.2.0.

One feature: webhook deliveries now retry with exponential backoff instead of dying after one try. The rest are fixes — worth flagging two in particular: expired tokens now return `401` instead of `403`, and the database layer stopped logging full request bodies. There's also a hang fix in the HTTP client, several crash and correctness fixes in pagination, allowlists, and trailing-slash handling, and some hot-path speedups.

I found no breaking changes in the log. Take a look at the entry before it goes out.
